API.reference_grid_xy: (shape_hw,policy)->int64[N,2] xy, y-major stride8 offset4, including edgeU

return.counts: JSON-ready shape/label/eligibility/reason counts and semantic flags
return.raw_center_residual_m: float64[H,W], direct supplied observed-rendered; nonfinite values preserved in map

actual_execution: Root separate exact frame/array trueentry only; no actual data loaded by this preparation.
limitations: Conditional front-rendered surfaceAUX only, not eight-slot native gold or q-pixel gold.
SAM/background plus depth policy does not infer SELF.
U is exclusion/unknown ground-truth support, not a correct model abstention.
No count-dependent threshold/view/data/model selection or training/adoption admitted.
